pr.body:
## Summary
Fixes the deterministic verifier so the already-complete restore, access-review, and oversight records are identified through their parent directory names. It also replaces deprecated Node 20 action pins with verified immutable Node 24 commits. Placeholder evidence remains rejected.

## Tickets
| Ticket | Title | Status |
|---|---|---|
| #56 | Verifier: recognize complete evidence in named directories | In Review |
| #58 | Workflows: migrate action pins to Node 24 | In Review |

## Changes
- `.shadow/ci/src/verify.rs` — match the path below `evidence/` and add a regression test.
- `.github/workflows/compliance.yml`
- `.github/workflows/daily-verify.yml`
- `.github/workflows/deploy.yml`
- `.github/workflows/deterministic-dashboard.yml`
- `.github/workflows/quarterly-rituals.yml`

## Test Plan
- [x] Deterministic verifier/control tests — 26 passed
- [x] Rust format check
- [x] All workflow YAML parses
- [x] No mutable third-party action refs remain
- [x] Deprecated Node 20 action commits are absent
- [x] Git diff whitespace check
